🩸 HbA1c Test – Information (in English)
🔬 What is HbA1c Test?
The HbA1c test (Hemoglobin A1c test) measures the average blood sugar level over the past 2 to 3 months. It shows how well diabetes is being controlled over time.
It is also called:
Glycated Hemoglobin test
A1c test
Diabetes control test

What is the Vitamin D3 Test?
The Vitamin D3 test (also called 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D Test) measures the level of vitamin D in your blood. It helps check if your body has enough vitamin D for healthy bones and immunity.

Free Thyroid Test (FT3, FT4, TSH) – Full Information with Images
🧠 What is a Free Thyroid Test?
A free thyroid test is a blood test that checks how well your thyroid gland is working. It mainly measures:
Free T3 (FT3) – active thyroid hormone
Free T4 (FT4) – main hormone produced by thyroid
TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone) – controls thyroid function
These tests help diagnose thyroid problems like hypothyroidism (low thyroid) and hyperthyroidism (high thyroid).  
Healthdirect +1
Types of Free Thyroid Tests
1. 🧪 Free T4 (FT4)
Measures free thyroxine (T4) in blood
More accurate than total T4
Shows how much hormone is available for body use  
MedlinePlus
👉 High FT4 → Hyperthyroidism
👉 Low FT4 → Hypothyroidism
2. 🧪 Free T3 (FT3)
Measures active hormone (T3)
T4 converts into T3 in the body
Controls metabolism, heart rate, energy  
Orange Health Labs
👉 High FT3 → Overactive thyroid
👉 Low FT3 → Underactive thyroid
3. 🧪 TSH Test
Produced by pituitary gland (brain)
Controls thyroid hormone production  
Cleveland Clinic
👉 High TSH → Hypothyroidism
👉 Low TSH → Hyperthyroidism  
NIDDK

The Vitamin B12 test measures the level of B12 in your blood to check for deficiency.
Why This Test is Done:
Detect Vitamin B12 deficiency
Diagnose anemia
Check nerve-related problems
Monitor overall nutritional health
Normal Range:
Typically 200 – 900 pg/mL (may vary by lab)
Symptoms of Low B12:
Fatigue & weakness
Numbness or tingling
Memory issues
Pale skin
Sample Required:
Simple blood sample from vein
Fasting usually not required

Lipid Profile is a blood test that measures fats (lipids) in your blood. It helps evaluate your heart health and risk of conditions like heart attack and stroke.

Preparation for LFT
Usually 8–12 hours fasting required
Avoid alcohol before test
Inform doctor about medicines

I would like to sincerely thank Suburban Diagnostics, Borivali West, for their beyond-par service and professionalism during a medical emergency. The entire team went out of their way to accommodate an urgent procedure with remarkable efficiency and compassion.

A special mention to Ms. Savita Sutar at the billing desk for her kindness, patience, and prompt assistance throughout the process. Such dedication, empathy, and customer care are rare to find. Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable diagnostics with a human touch.

featured_reviews.name: prashant acharya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Suburban Diagnostics today and had a truly excellent experience. From the blood tests to the breakfast and all the other investigations, everything was handled smoothly and efficiently. The entire setup was very well managed. The staff was supportive, the technicians were skilled, and the reception team was extremely cooperative. I genuinely appreciated the care and professionalism shown throughout.

I also underwent the TMT test under the guidance of Dr. Nitin Sonvane and Sister Varsha W. Both are very soft-spoken and ensured the entire process was comfortable and stress-free. Thank you so much for such wonderful care.
